vanilla_changes.change: Limit raised from 6 to 12 by default (config range 1-32 in config/bannertweaks.json5).

qol: Loom and banner copying work with the higher layer limit.
getting_started: Keep adding patterns in a loom past six layers.
editor_notes: Pack may override the default of 12; check client/overrides/config for bannertweaks.json5.
name: Banner Tweaks
summary: Raises the maximum number of pattern layers on a banner from vanilla's 6 to a configurable limit (default 12, up to 32). Looms, in-world rendering and map markers handle the taller stacks correctly. Made by the pack author.
